U_normal_solution:
import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()
n = int(data[0])
k = int(data[1])

if k * (k + 1) // 2 > n:
    print(-1)
else:
    d = (n - k * (k + 1) // 2) // k
    remainder = (n - k * (k + 1) // 2) % k
    sequence = [(i + 1 + d) for i in range(k)]
    for i in range(remainder):
        sequence[k - 1 - i] += 1
    for num in sequence:
        print(num)
